_source: Derived from server/services/aiService.js addCourseCompletions() and its stage scoring (score constants are the literal addCandidate(...) score arguments passed per stage; the journey order drink -> food -> wine -> upgrade -> dessert -> coffee -> digestif -> done is stated verbatim in the function's own comment).

stages.idealMoment: Right at the start of the meal, before anything is on the table yet — offer something to drink first (title: 'To start, something to drink').
Once a drink is ordered but no starter or main has been chosen — nudge toward food (title: 'Start with a starter or main').
Once a starter or main is on the table but no wine has been added yet — pour a bottle that pairs with it (title: 'Wine pairing').

recommendedSuggestionTypes: Premium upgrade — a same-role swap of the main dish already ordered (chef-curated, reuses replacement/EV logic)
stages.idealMoment: After food and wine are both on the table, when a curated premium upgrade exists for the main dish and hasn't been offered yet — the highest-priority nudge in the journey (title: 'Premium upgrade').
Once food, wine and the upgrade decision are settled — offer a sweet finish (title: 'Sweet finish').
After dessert has been addressed — offer a hot drink to close the meal (title: 'Coffee to finish').

The final stage of the journey, after coffee — offer an after-dinner spirit/port/amarula (title: 'An after-dinner drink'); once this is offered the journey is 'done' and no further recommendations are pushed.
